notes: The visual release: Crew Manager now wears a modern themed interface with TWO skins in Settings - Premium (calm blue-grey product dark, the new default) and Broadcast (the orange esports scoreboard). Flip between them anytime; open windows reskin instantly. Headline numbers now roll up like a jackpot counter when a new scan lands (toggle in Appearance). Also new since 1.0.4: Discord title roles that follow the report's winners; the day-locked MVP of the Night with a lifetime tally that never resets, All-Time MVP and a Top 5 MVPs board; the Ironman title; the Pumpfaker - a weekly title on the game's own week (Friday 11 AM ET reset) for the most-online, least-producing member, tallying for life like MVP; EVERY title name is yours to rename in Settings (names only - what each title means never changes); hover any member in Deep Dive or the Activity Log to see their title tallies; Mark as kicked in both the Activity Log and the name Review; a 'Since last scan' banner on the main window; the Activity Log with true days-inactive, rhythm-based statuses (Active and Casual now run on bars you set yourself in Settings - defaults 4+ days a week and 80+ XP in 7 days; Casual replaces Quiet), sorting and filters; and report fixes (Danger Zone printing twice, local 'since' date, ex-members in the Danger Zone).
